translations.text: In the thirtieth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth day of the month, I was among the captives beside the Chebar River. The heavens opened, and I saw visions of God.
On the fifth day of the month, in the fifth year of King Jehoiakim’s exile,
the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans beside the Chebar River. The hand of the Lord came down upon me.

I looked, and there was a [?], rising and coming from the north, with a great cloud in it, light around it, and flashing fire. In its midst was something resembling an amber stone, in the midst of the fire, with light within it.
In its midst was the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: they had a human likeness.
Each had four faces, and each had four wings.
Their legs were straight, and their feet were winged, with sparks of fire like gleaming bronze. Their wings were light.
There was a human hand beneath their wings. They moved on their four sides, and the faces of the four
did not turn backward as they moved. Each moved straight ahead in the direction of its face.
Their faces looked like this: all four had a human face and a lion’s face on their right, and all four had a calf’s face on their left, and an eagle’s face.
Or they may be afraid, because they are a rebellious household. They will know that you are a prophet among them.

But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them, do not be disturbed, and do not shrink back in their presence, because they will rage and gather around you. You are living among them as among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or be disturbed in their presence, because they are a rebellious household.
You are to speak my words to them, whether they listen or are afraid, because they are a rebellious household.
But you, son of man, listen to the one speaking to you. Do not be rebellious like the rebellious household. Open your mouth and eat what I will give you.
I looked, and there was a hand stretched out toward me, with a scroll in it.
He unrolled it before me. It was written on the inside and the outside, and a lament, a song, and a cry of woe were written on it.
He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll, then go and speak with the children of [?].”
He [?] my mouth and fed me the scroll.
He said to me, “Son of man, your mouth will open, and your heart will die from this scroll that I have given you.” So I ate it, and in my mouth it was like sweet honey.
He said to me, “Son of man, go, enter the household of [?], and speak my words to them.
For I am not sending you to the household of [?] as to a people whose speech is foreign,
nor to many peoples whose voice or language is foreign, or whose speech is difficult, whose words you cannot understand. If I had sent you to people like these, they would have listened to you.
But the household of [?] will not be willing to listen to you, because they are not willing to listen to me. For the whole household of [?] is contentious and hardhearted.
Look, I have made your face firm before them, and I will make your forehead strong against their forehead.
Your face will always be firm before them, like a rock. Do not be afraid of them or be disturbed in their presence, because they are a rebellious household.”
And he said to me, “Son of man, put all the words I have spoken to you in your heart, and listen with your ears.
Go into captivity, to the children of your people, and speak with them. Tell them, ‘These are the things the Lord, the Lord, says,’ whether they will humble themselves.
And I heard behind me the sound: “Blessed is the glory of the Lord from his place.”
And there was the sound of [?] striking against one another, and the sound of the wheels close to them, and the sound of the rumbling.
And the [?] lifted me and took me away, and I went in the impulse of my [?]. And the Lord’s hand came upon me with strength.
And I went to the captives, to those living by the River Chebar, who were staying in that place, [?] while I stayed among them.
And after the seven days, the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
“Son of man, [?] the house of [?]. And you will hear a word from my mouth, and [?] through me.
When I say to the lawless person, ‘You will certainly die,’ [?] nor did you [?] his ways [?], that lawless person will die in his wrongdoing, and I will hold you responsible for his blood.
You, son of man, take a brick, put it in front of you, and draw the city of Jerusalem on it.
And lay siege to it, build walls against it, besiege it, set camps against it, and establish positions for shooting arrows all around it.
And take an iron pan and set it as an iron wall between you and the city. Fix your face against it, and it will be under siege, and you will besiege it. This is a sign for the children of [?].
You are to lie on your left side and put the wrongdoings of the house of [?] upon it. For the number of days you spend lying on it—150 days—you will bear their wrongdoings.
I have assigned you their two wrongdoings as a number of days: 190 days. And you will bear the wrongdoings of the house of [?].
And you will lie on your right side and bear the wrongdoings of the house of Judah for forty days. I have assigned you one day for each year.
And you shall set your face toward the siege against [?].
And look, I have put bonds upon you, and you will not turn from one side to the other until the days of the siege are completed.

And take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt. Put them in a clay vessel and make bread for yourself from them. For the number of days you lie on your side—190 days—you will spend them eating these.
And you shall eat your food in measured portions, twenty shekels by weight each day; you shall eat it from time to time.
And you will drink water by measure, one-sixth of a hin. You will drink it at set intervals.
And you will eat them as a barley cake, and bake them over human dung in their sight.
And tell them, ‘These are the things the Lord, the God of [?], says: This is how the children of [?] will eat unclean food among the nations.’

And I said, “No, Lord God, [?]! For this is how my soul is: it has not been defiled with impurity. I have not eaten any animal torn by a wild beast, or meat from an animal that died, from my birth up to this day. Nor has any unclean meat entered my mouth.”
And he said to me, “Look, I have given you cattle dung in place of human dung, and you will make your bread over it.”
And he said to me, “Son of man, look, I will break the support of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat their bread by measure and in distress, and they will drink water by measure and amid ruin,
so that they lack bread and water, and each person is destroyed along with his brother, and they waste away in their wrongdoings.
You, son of man, take a sword sharper than a barber’s razor, use it for yourself, and pass it over your head and your beard. Then take a balance and weigh the hair.

Burn one-quarter of it in a fire in the middle of the city when the number of days of the siege is completed. Take another quarter and cut it up with the sword all around the city. Scatter another quarter to every wind, and I will draw a sword behind them.
And you will take a small number from there and tie them in the hem of your garment.
And again you will take some of these and throw them into the middle of the fire and burn them in the fire, so that a fire comes out immediately. And you will say to the whole house of [?]:
For this is what the Lord says: “This is Jerusalem, which I placed in the midst of the nations, with the countries surrounding it.”
And you will declare my judgments to the lawless woman among the nations, and my laws to the countries around her, because they rejected my judgments and did not follow my laws.

Therefore this is what the Lord Adonai says: Because your motivation comes from the nations around you, and you have not followed my laws or carried out my judgments, nor have you acted according to the judgments of the nations around you,
therefore this is what the Lord Adonai says: Look, I am against you, and I will carry out judgment among you in the sight of the nations.
And I will do within you things I have never done, and from now on I will never do anything like them.
Therefore fathers will eat their children among you, and children will eat their fathers. And I will carry out judgments among you and scatter all those who remain to every wind.
Therefore, as I live, says Adonai the Lord, because you have defiled my holy places with all your abominations, I too will cast you out. My eye will not spare you, and I will not have mercy on you.

A fourth of them will perish by death, and a fourth of them will perish by famine among you. A fourth of them I will scatter to every wind, and a fourth of them will fall by the sword all around them. And I will draw a sword behind them.
Then my anger and my wrath will be fully poured out upon them. And you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in my jealousy, when I have fully poured out my wrath upon them.
And I will make you a wasteland and a reproach in their surroundings, in the sight of everyone who passes by,
And you will groan and be wretched among the nations surrounding you, when I carry out judgments within you in the vengeance of my wrath. I, the Lord, have spoken.
when I send my arrows of famine to fall upon them. They will be destructive, and I will break their supply of bread.

And I will send a sword and famine upon you, along with vicious wild animals, and I will afflict you. Death and bloodshed will come upon you, and I will bring a sword upon you all around them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
